name.zh: 死亡会损失练出的能力

summary.zh: 失败不只丢物品，还会损失一部分练习成果。
summary.en: Death can cost training as well as possessions.

rules.zh: 角色死亡后，已练出的熟练度下降，或新角色不再拥有前一人的训练成果。玩家因此要衡量继续冒险的收益与重新练习的成本；找回装备和找回能力是两回事。
rules.en: Death reduces trained proficiency, or a successor does not inherit the previous character’s training. Compare the benefit of pushing farther with the cost of retraining. Recovering equipment and recovering abilities are separate concerns.

decisions.zh: 带着已经练强的角色去冒险，还是暂时撤退保住训练成果？
decisions.en: Risk a well-trained character or retreat to protect that investment?

decisions.zh: 损失后先练回原本优势，还是趁机会改练另一种生存方法？
decisions.en: Rebuild the former specialty or develop a different way to survive?

effect.zh: 损失大时撤退更有意义，也更容易让玩家反复做低风险练习。
effect.en: Large losses make retreat meaningful but encourage repetitive safe training.

effect.zh: 重新练习若能换路线，就比强迫重复同一段动作更有选择。
effect.en: Recovery offers more agency when retraining can use another route rather than repeat identical actions.

implementation.zh: 死亡通常会降低技能熟练度，装备回收不等于恢复全部训练成果；实际惩罚力度会受世界设置影响。
implementation.en: Death normally reduces skill proficiency; recovering equipment does not restore all training. The penalty’s strength depends on world settings.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：角色面对巨魔，展示冒险风险；画面没有死亡后技能变化。
observation.en: System reference: a character faces a troll, illustrating danger but not post-death skill changes.

cases.rights: Iron Gate AB / Coffee Stain Publishing

implementation.zh: 角色死亡后，可在仍保留的世界中建立新角色，但前一人练出的技能经验不会随之继承。新角色仍有由职业与特征带来的初始技能。
implementation.en: After death, a new character can enter the retained world but does not inherit the previous character’s earned skill experience. Occupation and traits still provide starting skills.

observation.zh: 场景参考图：夜间住宅区与道路可见；此图不显示人物死亡或技能重建。
observation.en: Scene reference: homes and roads at night are visible; character death and retraining are not shown.

contrast.zh: 《英灵神殿》通常削减同一人物的熟练度；《僵尸毁灭工程》让旧人物死亡，新人物重新建立自己的技能成长。
contrast.en: Valheim normally reduces the same character’s proficiency; Project Zomboid ends that character and starts another person’s training.

combination.zh: 设计提案：死亡后工具留在原地可取回，但工具使用经验下降；玩家要决定立即冒险取回，还是先用备用工具练习。
combination.en: Design proposal: tools remain recoverable after death while tool proficiency drops; decide between immediate retrieval and training with a spare.

setup.zh: 你的攀爬熟练度为 10，远处有奖励，但体力只剩一半。
setup.en: Climbing proficiency is 10, and a reward lies farther ahead, but stamina is half full.

action.zh: 你继续攀爬却跌落；本例规定死亡扣除 2 点熟练度。
action.en: You push on and fall; this example removes 2 proficiency on death.

result.zh: 重新出发时装备能找回，攀爬熟练度却只剩 8。
result.en: Your gear can be recovered, but climbing proficiency is now 8.

next.zh: 下一次先走安全路线练回能力，或承担更低熟练度继续挑战。
next.en: Retrain on a safer route or face the challenge with lower proficiency.

firstStep.zh: 做一条安全练习路线和一条高风险路线，只有一个熟练度数值与清楚的死亡扣减。
firstStep.en: Build a safe training route, a risky route and one proficiency value with an explicit death deduction.

pitfall.zh: 先别让大量技能一起掉；玩家若不知道失去什么，惩罚只会变成模糊挫败。
pitfall.en: Avoid reducing many skills at once; unclear losses create frustration without a useful decision.

test.zh: 临近危险时玩家是否主动撤退，死亡后又能准确说明需要恢复什么？
test.en: Do players sometimes retreat near danger and accurately explain what needs rebuilding after death?
